const BUILDING_DESIGNS_V112 = Object.freeze({
  '長老之家':[0,0],       '旅行商店':[6,0],     '轉職殿堂':[9,0],
  '鍛造坊':[1,0],         '星燈學院':[8,0],     '療癒所':[5,0],
  '晨光麵包坊':[4,0],     '花香旅店':[2,0],
  '斥候營房':[11,0],      '補給站':[15,0],
  '森林議事所':[10,0],    '精靈商鋪':[3,0],     '葉語醫院':[12,0],
  '月光研究室':[14,0],    '泉水商店':[6,1],
  '礦工要塞':[7,0],       '物資站':[13,0],     '軍醫營房':[5,2]
});
function bldg(c,x,y,w,h,label,roof='green'){
  const atlas=PIXEL_ART.buildingAtlas16;
  const spec=BUILDING_DESIGNS_V112[label];
  c.save();
  if(atlas && atlas.complete && atlas.naturalWidth && spec){
    const idx=spec[0], variant=spec[1];
    const sw=atlas.naturalWidth/4, sh=atlas.naturalHeight/4;
    c.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;
    c.drawImage(atlas,Math.round(idx%4*sw),Math.round(Math.floor(idx/4)*sh),Math.floor(sw),Math.floor(sh), Math.round(x),Math.round(y),Math.round(w),Math.round(h));
    c.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
    if(variant===1){
      // Distinctive blue hanging sign and flower boxes for the waterside shop.
      c.fillStyle='#23586a';c.fillRect(x+w*.78,y+h*.29,w*.14,h*.29);
      c.strokeStyle='#e4ce8a';c.lineWidth=2;c.strokeRect(x+w*.78,y+h*.29,w*.14,h*.29);
      c.fillStyle='#fff0b6';c.font='bold 17px serif';c.textAlign='center';c.fillText('✧',x+w*.85,y+h*.48);
      c.fillStyle='#347e51';c.fillRect(x+w*.16,y+h*.8,w*.21,8);
      c.fillStyle='#f6c4de';for(let i=0;i<4;i++)c.fillRect(x+w*.17+i*11,y+h*.78,5,5);
    } else if(variant===2){
      // Medical annex is a different variant of the apothecary.
      c.fillStyle='#20483f';c.fillRect(x+w*.75,y+h*.28,w*.17,h*.26);
      c.strokeStyle='#f6e6b7';c.lineWidth=2;c.strokeRect(x+w*.75,y+h*.28,w*.17,h*.26);
      c.fillStyle='#e2f5db';c.fillRect(x+w*.82,y+h*.32,5,23);
      c.fillRect(x+w*.785,y+h*.39,25,5);
    }
  }else{
    const im=PIXEL_ART['building_'+roof];
    if(im && im.complete && im.naturalWidth) c.drawImage(im,0,0,144,112,x,y,w,h);
    else {c.fillStyle='#d6c29a';c.fillRect(x,y+35,w,h-35);c.fillStyle='#356758';c.fillRect(x,y,w,52)}
  }
  // v1.1.3: one unobtrusive wall-mounted plaque, instead of a wide floating label.
  const tw=Math.min(w-24,Math.max(78,label.length*12.5+18)), sx=x+(w-tw)/2, sy=y+Math.max(25,h*.31);
  c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='middle';c.shadowColor='transparent';c.shadowBlur=0;
  c.fillStyle='#173a30d8';c.fillRect(sx,sy,tw,19);
  c.strokeStyle='#c7b17d99';c.lineWidth=1;c.strokeRect(sx+.5,sy+.5,tw-1,18);
  c.fillStyle='#f7e5bb';c.font='bold 12px "Noto Sans TC",system-ui';c.fillText(label,x+w/2,sy+9.5);
  c.restore();
}

function swActorFocusV113(n){
  if(!swFocusedTargetV113 || swFocusedTargetV113.o!==n)return;
  g.save();
  g.strokeStyle='#e5c88be6';g.lineWidth=2;
  g.beginPath();g.ellipse(n.x,n.y+31,27,8,0,0,TWO);g.stroke();
  g.fillStyle='#f8e2a8';g.font='bold 14px system-ui';g.textAlign='center';
  g.fillText('✦',n.x,n.y-47);
  g.restore();
}
drawNPC=function(n){
  g.save();g.globalAlpha=1;g.shadowBlur=0;
  g.fillStyle='#0a1b1795';g.beginPath();g.ellipse(n.x,n.y+29,23,7,0,0,TWO);g.fill();
  if(n.id.includes('board'))objDraw('book',n.x,n.y+20,60,71);
  else actorDraw(n.actor||n.id,n.x,n.y+20,0,0,68,68);
  // No permanent NPC names or duplicate "F 交談" labels above or below sprites.
  swActorFocusV113(n);
  g.restore();
};

  }
  g.restore();
};
function swPromptV113(t){
  if(!t)return AREAS[s.area].safe?'🛡 安全區 · 探索城鎮':'⚔ 野外戰鬥區 · 小心怪物';
  const name=t.o.name||'互動物件';
  if(t.kind==='npc')return '💬 '+name+' · F 交談';
  if(t.kind==='ambient')return '💬 '+name+' · F 對話';
  if(t.kind==='furniture')return '🔍 '+name+' · F 查看';
  if(t.kind==='door'||t.kind==='gate')return '🚪 '+name+' · F 進入';
  return '🌿 '+name+' · F 採集';
}
